sections.content: *Kérek* belongs to the verb *kér* (to ask for, to want). It is a regular verb, so with the other persons it changes like the verbs you know. To ask a friend what he or she wants, use *kérsz*: *Mit kérsz?* (What would you like?) *Kérsz kávét?* (Would you like coffee?)

sections.title: Yes and no
sections.content: A short yes is *Igen, kérek.* and a short no is *Nem kérek.* With a food, add the object: *Nem kérek tejet.* (I do not want milk.)

items.english: Anna does not want a cake.

sections.content: The question *Kérsz teát?* asks about you (*te*). The reply uses *én*: *Igen, kérek.* Do not repeat *kérsz* in the answer.
